verdict.rationale: The evidence implies that items (tasks) can be created and assigned: there is a `create_item` event, and agents can be assigned items "like teammates." It never explicitly documents assigning tasks to human teammates or setting due dates. missing for 10: explicit docs for creating tasks and assigning them to human teammates, due-date fields or scheduling on tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: Talk to agents like teammates. Message them in updates, assign them items
Fire when an agent is messaged, assigned an item, or mentioned in an update.
